changes.comment: Question cards are addressed exactly as `reply` is: an explicit message id sends the card as a reply to that message, and without one the card is created in the chat. A submitted, dismissed, or expired answer is routed from the card it belongs to, whose chat and topic are read back from Feishu, instead of from a target computed before the card was sent; a follow-up question therefore stays in the topic its answer came from. An answer whose card cannot be located is a failed delivery rather than a message sent to a guessed chat.
